_why: The generic stub infers a native function's return shape from its NAME. That guess is wrong for the tuning backend in ways that silently empty the Tuning tab: getOctaveStretch matches /^get/ and returns null, so `stretch.toFixed(2)` throws out of loadInitialState() before updateIntervalList(), updateVisualization() and updateScaleNameDisplay() ever run; getEmbeddedTuningList matches /List$/ and returns an ARRAY where the page does JSON.parse(), so the library list stays empty and label.noteCount is never rendered; and getTonicNote returns null, so the tonic readout renders the string 'undefined'. Every value below is the plugin's own real default, so check-ui-labels measures the panel a user actually sees rather than a half-collapsed one.
